import json
import os
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

REPOS = [
  ("jev-mcp", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/jev-mcp", "6ec5efc"),
  ("jev-review", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/jev-review", "57690af"),
  ("jev-ultrafast", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/jev-ultrafast", "452c1ad"),
  ("jev-router", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/jev-router", "86660a0"),
  ("jev-codex-router", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/jev-codex-router", "8292b51"),
  ("jev-rerank-bench", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/jev-rerank-bench", "cd9a35b"),
  ("jev-phishing-bench", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/jev-phishing-bench", "1d56e8c"),
  ("jev-sec-bench", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/jev-sec-bench", "fdb16b9"),
  ("jev-spam-eval", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/jev-spam-eval", "76ef183"),
  ("jev-agent-failure-benchmark", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/jev-agent-failure-benchmark", "4d46af7"),
  ("commit-miner", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/commit-miner", "977617e"),
  ("foreman", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/foreman", "2c43982"),
  ("bicameral", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/bicameral", "3bea244"),
  ("s1-rs", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/s1-rs", "b916897"),
  ("fast-jev-compaction", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/fast-jev-compaction", "6e1da50"),
  ("skillranker", "/Users/josh/Developer/jev/skillranker", "3fe85c4"),
]
TOKENS = ("TODO", "FIXME", "HACK", "XXX")
EXCLUDES = (":!vendor/**", ":!node_modules/**", ":!dist/**", ":!build/**", ":!target/**")


def run_git(root, args, check=True):
    p = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", root, *args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if check and p.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"git -C {root} {' '.join(args)} rc={p.returncode}: {p.stderr.decode(errors='replace').strip()}")
    return p

results = []
failures = []
for name, root, expected_prefix in REPOS:
    row = {"name": name, "path": root, "expected_sha_prefix": expected_prefix, "failures": []}
    try:
        sha = run_git(root, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"]).stdout.decode().strip()
        remote = run_git(root, ["config", "--get", "remote.origin.url"], check=False).stdout.decode().strip()
        row["sha"] = sha
        row["remote"] = remote
        if not sha.startswith(expected_prefix):
            row["failures"].append(f"HEAD {sha} does not match pinned prefix {expected_prefix}")
        tracked = run_git(root, ["ls-files", "-z", "--", *EXCLUDES]).stdout
        paths = [p.decode(errors="surrogateescape") for p in tracked.split(b"\0") if p]
        total_lines = 0
        text_files = 0
        for rel in paths:
            try:
                data = open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb").read()
            except OSError as exc:
                row["failures"].append(f"read {rel}: {exc}")
                continue
            if b"\0" in data:
                continue
            text_files += 1
            total_lines += data.count(b"\n")
        row["tracked_text_files"] = text_files
        row["kloc"] = total_lines / 1000.0
        counts = {}
        for token in TOKENS:
            pattern = f"(^|[^[:alnum:]_]){token}([^[:alnum:]_]|$)"
            p = run_git(root, ["grep", "-I", "-h", "-o", "-E", pattern, "--", *EXCLUDES], check=False)
            if p.returncode not in (0, 1):
                row["failures"].append(f"git grep {token} rc={p.returncode}: {p.stderr.decode(errors='replace').strip()}")
                counts[token] = None
            else:
                counts[token] = len(p.stdout.splitlines())
        row["markers"] = counts
        row["total_markers"] = sum(v for v in counts.values() if v is not None)
        row["markers_per_kloc"] = (row["total_markers"] / row["kloc"]) if row["kloc"] else None
    except Exception as exc:
        row["failures"].append(str(exc))
    failures.extend({"repo": name, "failure": f} for f in row["failures"])
    results.append(row)

counts = [r["total_markers"] for r in results if not r["failures"]]
counts_sorted = sorted(counts)
median = None
if counts_sorted:
    mid = len(counts_sorted) // 2
    median = counts_sorted[mid] if len(counts_sorted) % 2 else (counts_sorted[mid - 1] + counts_sorted[mid]) / 2

total = sum(counts)
top = max(results, key=lambda r: r.get("total_markers", -1), default=None)
receipt = {
    "schema": "jev.duel2.muh1-marker-census.v1",
    "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
    "method": {
        "marker_tokens": list(TOKENS),
        "marker_count": "one count per token occurrence from git grep -I -h -o -E",
        "kloc": "newline count in tracked, non-binary files",
        "excluded_pathspecs": list(EXCLUDES),
        "model_discovery": False,
    },
    "repositories": results,
    "distribution": {
        "repo_count": len(results),
        "successful_repo_count": len(counts),
        "nonzero_repo_count": sum(1 for x in counts if x > 0),
        "zero_repo_count": sum(1 for x in counts if x == 0),
        "total_markers": total,
        "mean_markers_per_repo": (total / len(counts)) if counts else None,
        "median_markers_per_repo": median,
        "max_repo": {"name": top["name"], "total_markers": top["total_markers"]} if top else None,
        "max_repo_share": (top["total_markers"] / total) if top and total else None,
        "sorted_counts": counts_sorted,
    },
    "study_denominator": {
        "label_free_census_supports_200_marker_study": total >= 200,
        "reason": "actionability is intentionally not inferred from marker text; labels are required for that half",
    },
    "failures": failures,
}
print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
